Item: Kumantong Kaew Saraphat Nuek 4 Faces 9 Eyes

 

Made by:  Arjarn Subin Nanatong

Size: Bucha 5 Inches

 

Year: B.E.2557 (Chanted on July 8, 2014)

 

Made amount: Ong Kru or Special Type made in 99 pcs

 

This Kumantong  have special more than any Kumantong because have 4 faces and 9 eyes. This Kumantong name is "Kumantong Kaew Saraphat Nuek 4 Faces 9 Eyes". "Kaew Saraphat Nuek" is Wishing crystal. When You Own Crystal Wish That means you desire anything, you'll have everything you need and then "Kumantong Kaew Saraphat Nuek 4 Faces 9 Eyes" makes you wish for everything as well.

 

 

All 9 species of wood embedded in Kumantong 4 Faces 9 Eyes. The meaning of 9 species of wood.

1. Rajchaphruek Wood means having power.
2. Chaiyaphruek Wood means having a lucky victory.
3. Thonglang Wood means have the money and a lot of gold.
4. Shongbadal Wood means strong and stability.
5. Kunkroun Wood means to prevent such harm.
6. Teak Wood means Honor and high position
7. Sheesuk bamboo means happy.
8. Jackfruit Wood (Khanoon) means someone help and support.
9. Payoong Wood means help make better business.

8. Sleep with the amulet nearby to continue its work through your dreams

Proven Results from Devotees

 

Those who have worshiped this edition of Kuman Thong have reported achieving their desires, gaining wealth, and enjoying successful businesses. It has become highly popular among spiritual practitioners, with disciples experiencing positive outcomes—prosperity, fortune, and thriving commerce.

 

Assured Spiritual Potency

 

This master-level edition was consecrated following the auspicious principles of Tham 18 Koti, ensuring the statues radiate strong spiritual energy. Devotees can confidently worship this Kuman Thong Mahaveero to attract wealth, prosperity, and success beyond expectations.

Product Description

Kuman Thong Maha Ruay (Great Wealth Edition) - Gold with Red Base

 

By Luang Pu Yaem, Wat Sam Ngam, Nakhon Pathom

• Material: Sacred Clay from 7 Cemeteries

• Year of Creation: 2015 (B.E. 2558)

• Special Marking: Engraved “Y” Code Under the Base

 

Sacred Power & Protection

 

The Kuman Thong from Wat Sam Ngam is highly revered for its protective and auspicious qualities. It serves as a spiritual shield, guarding its owner from harm, misfortune, and negative influences. Those who worship Kuman Thong are believed to gain protection from unseen dangers and have their bad karma alleviated.

 

Wealth, Fortune & Business Prosperity

 

Beyond protection, this edition of Kuman Thong is known for its wealth-attracting properties. It is ideal for business owners, merchants, and entrepreneurs looking to enhance their success and expand their ventures. By properly worshipping this sacred object, one can experience steady financial growth, prosperity, and stability.

 

How to Worship for Maximum Efficacy

• Maintain a focused and respectful mindset while worshipping.

• Sincerely communicate your wishes, and strive to do good deeds to enhance your merit.

• Make merit regularly and dedicate it to Kuman Thong.

• Offer food on sacred days (Wanek Phra or Buddhist Holy Days), such as rice and boiled eggs.

• Ensure a constant supply of clean water on the altar.

• Fulfill your vows promptly when your wishes are granted. Suitable offerings include milk, sweets, Thong Yip, Thong Yod, pizza, toys, cars, or footballs.

 

By maintaining consistent and proper worship, Kuman Thong will bless its owner with a smooth, obstacle-free life and continuous financial success.

 

This is an authentic Kuman Thong, consecrated by Luang Pu Yaem, Wat Sam Ngam.

Kuman Thong by Luang Por Yaem, Wat Sam Ngam – Maha Setthi Edition, Medium Size, Year 2011

 

This Kuman Thong is made from sacred Phong Prai Kuman powder mixed with soil from seven cemeteries, following the same tradition as Luang Por Tae Kongthong. Key Blessings and Powers

• Attracts wealth and continuous financial success

• Enhances business prosperity and trade
